principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class is solely responsible for payment processing, but it is also tightly coupled with the Order class to manage order status, which leads to a mix of responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an OrderStatusManager class to handle the order status updates. This will separate order management from payment processing.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class directly depends on the Order class to change its state, violating the Dependency Inversion Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use an interface or an abstract class for payment processors which can handle different orders. This will allow for easier testing and flexibility to add new types of order processing.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
